title: Thank you
description: chapbook-walk-20261125: thank you, what happens next and how to choose a time.

data.heading: Thank you, that is *all done*
data.intro: Whether you have booked a time, paid or both, an email is on its way to you. Here is what happens next.

items.name: Check your email
items.description: A payment receipt comes from the payment service, and a booking confirmation from the booking service. No email after a few minutes? Check your spam folder, or get in touch.

items.name: Choose your time, if you have not yet
items.description: If you paid before booking, pick a time that suits you now.

items.name: Need to change something?
items.description: Use the link in your confirmation email to move or cancel your booking, or get in touch and we will sort it out.

data.heading: Not booked a time yet?
data.body: Choose a time online, or call and we will find one with you.
